criteria.name: a_failing_chord_carries_the_originating
criteria.description: A failing chord carries the originating exception rather than a substitute, and the diff implements task-queue behaviour.
criteria.reasoning: ChordError wrappers now retain the originating exception as __cause__, and group chord bodies unwrap that cause so their tasks and errbacks are failed with the original exception. This is implemented in the Celery backend/task-queue paths.

criteria.name: the_worker_can_be_told_not_to_prefetch
criteria.description: The worker can be told not to prefetch, and only a Redis broker honours it.
criteria.reasoning: The setting and CLI option exist, but honoring it is gated only on the channel QoS object exposing can_consume. There is no Redis transport check, so other virtual transports with that method can honor it as well.

criteria.name: the_consumer_cancels_requests_in_flight
criteria.description: The consumer cancels requests in flight, and an individual cancel chooses whether to retry.
criteria.reasoning: Consumer.cancel_active_requests iterates active requests and cancels them, while Request.cancel now has an emit_retry parameter. Late-acknowledged requests are canceled with retry announcement disabled.

criteria.name: control_and_event_queues_each_declare_du
criteria.description: Control and event queues each declare durability and exclusivity from their own settings.
criteria.reasoning: Control mailbox queues use control_queue_durable and control_queue_exclusive, while event receiver queues independently use event_queue_durable and event_queue_exclusive. Conflicting durable/exclusive combinations are also rejected.

criteria.name: the_queue_created_for_an_unknown_route_t
criteria.description: The queue created for an unknown route takes its type from configuration or an explicit parameter.
criteria.reasoning: Automatically created queues take their queue type from create_missing_queue_type, supplied explicitly to Queues or obtained from task_create_missing_queue_type. Non-classic types receive the appropriate x-queue-type argument.

criteria.name: consumption_admission_is_bounded_by_in_f
criteria.description: Consumption admission is bounded by in-flight work against the effective concurrency limit, and otherwise defers to the original check.
criteria.reasoning: The patched can_consume rejects admission when reserved_requests reaches the effective autoscaler, controller, or pool concurrency limit, and otherwise invokes the original can_consume check.

criteria.name: binding_delayed_delivery_queues_retries
criteria.description: Binding delayed-delivery queues retries a defined set of transient failures.
criteria.reasoning: RETRIED_EXCEPTIONS defines the transient failures, retry_over_time catches that set, and queue binding re-raises those exceptions directly so the complete setup is retried.

criteria.name: django_teardown_suppresses_a_vanished_co
criteria.description: Django teardown suppresses a vanished connection pool but lets a cache failure propagate.
criteria.reasoning: Database pool closure suppresses KeyError for an already-vanished pool, while close_cache no longer catches TypeError or AttributeError, allowing cache teardown failures to propagate.

criteria.name: a_chord_body_receives_an_identity_derive
criteria.description: A chord body receives an identity derived from the chord rather than a fabricated placeholder.
criteria.reasoning: The chord freezes its body with the chord task identity and, when the body itself lacks an ID, assigns the ID from the frozen body result rather than leaving or manufacturing an unrelated placeholder.

criteria.name: the_eager_application_path_builds_its_re
criteria.description: The eager application path builds its request with lineage read from the task stack when a calling task is present.
criteria.reasoning: Task.apply now builds parent_id and root_id before constructing its eager request, consulting _task_stack.top and its request whenever explicit lineage values are absent.

criteria.name: a_corrupted_stored_schedule_is_rebuilt_r
criteria.description: A corrupted stored schedule is rebuilt rather than silently swallowed.
criteria.reasoning: The schedule load error set now includes EOF and pickle unpickling failures, and _create_schedule handles those failures by recreating the entries mapping. Corrupted metadata is also logged rather than silently ignored.

criteria.name: termination_on_failure_and_on_timeout_re
criteria.description: Termination on failure and on timeout reports through the shared path rather than a bespoke one.
criteria.reasoning: The change adds early-return guards for already canceled or revoked requests, but hard-timeout reporting still has its bespoke mark_as_failure and task-failed event logic. Failure and timeout reporting were not refactored through one shared reporting path.
